meta.title: TinyConvNet: A Small Convolutional Classifier for Grayscale Digit Recognition

questions.text: How effective is TinyConvNet for classifying grayscale digit images?
questions.goal: To evaluate the performance of TinyConvNet on a digit classification task.
questions.source_text: TinyConvNet reaches over 98% test accuracy on a held-out split of a standard handwritten-digit dataset.

questions.text: What is the architecture of TinyConvNet?
questions.goal: To describe the components and structure of the TinyConvNet model.
questions.source_text: TinyConvNet processes a single-channel 28x28 input through the following stages.

questions.text: What dataset is used for training TinyConvNet?
questions.goal: To identify the dataset characteristics and preprocessing steps.
questions.source_text: The model is trained on a standard 10-class handwritten-digit dataset of 28x28 grayscale images.

questions.text: What training procedure is followed for TinyConvNet?
questions.goal: To outline the training process including loss, optimizer, and hyperparameters.
questions.source_text: The model is trained with cross-entropy loss and the Adam optimizer.

questions.goal: To detail the evaluation metrics and methods used.
questions.source_text: We report top-1 accuracy on the 10,000-image held-out test split.
